goal: Ship v2.0.0-rc.3: guided conversational Harness construction as one closed loop. On /harness:init, the Agent drives a natural conversation, synthesizes a structured Brief, and only after user confirmation does the deterministic Bash executor (scripts/harness-init.sh) write files per the output manifest. Executor, dialog layer, shell tests, forward eval, and acceptance ship together.

initial_project_state.detection_summary: Self-host bootstrap of harness-companion at v2.0.0-rc.2 (HEAD c5ca212). Origin: legacy-unmanaged (manual init, no prior snapshot). Current: managed-valid (valid snapshot).

success_criteria: Deterministic executor: scripts/harness-init.sh accepts --brief (guided/quick) and legacy callers, and writes the §6.2a output manifest from a validated Brief — atomically, idempotently, re-entrant via 3-way SHA compare
Zero writes before Brief confirmation in guided mode; Brief state lives only in conversation context until the user approves

Conversational dialog layer: SKILL.md + reference files drive a natural Agent-led dialog — never re-ask known info, explain decisions, confirm the Brief not the plan, post-init explanation covers generated/inferred/defaulted/deferred
Type-matched templates: templates/ restructured into common/ + by-type/, core/lib/project-detect.sh extended, and the template manifest snapshot records origin for resume/update
14 forward-eval conversation scenarios pass with a real Agent (vague goals, conflicts, unfamiliar users, rejection/modification, authorization denial, clean-archive end-to-end)
Shell tests cover executor determinism, type-matching, zero-writes, resume safety, and cross-host equality; legacy Bash callers still work with placeholder-filled Briefs

All rc.3 work contained within this repository; zero writes to ~/.claude/, ~/.agents/, or local install paths; acceptance package (F-CONV-09) presented and release-ready; release requires separate user authorization
